artifact_reason: The replica notes state that `issues(filter:…)` ignores the `subscribers` filter. At step 7 the solver queried `issues(filter: {team:{id:{eq:"t-web"}}, subscribers:{id:{eq:"u-dana"}}})` and the replica returned only i-63 (WEB-3), which is not actually Dana's subscription (she only created it). Since the server accepted and silently ignored the subscribers condition, the solver reasonably trusted the filtered result — it never even saw a subscribers field to check, since the query only projected id/identifier/title/priority. The real service would not have returned this record for that filter.
note: Step 7's subscribers filter is documented as ignored by the replica, yet returned only the decoy i-63, which the solver then updated at step 9. This is a replica artifact rather than a grounding failure, since the solver correctly attempted server-side filtering on the exact deciding condition and had no visibility into the actual subscriber list to catch the discrepancy.
